transcript:
Header:
Date: 2025-04-08
Start time: 15:30 UTC (08:30 PDT)
Duration: ~54 minutes
Attendees: Lena Park (Redwood), Carlos Mendoza (Redwood), Priya Singh (Redwood), Ethan Li (Redwood), Maya Patel (VectorBase), Tom Reynolds (VectorBase), Sasha Ivanov (VectorBase)

[00:00] Lena Park: Hey everyone, thanks for joining. Quick check — can you hear me okay?
[00:05] Maya Patel: Yep, loud and clear.
[00:12] Carlos Mendoza: Good morning, all. I think we have most folks, should be a quick sync to lock down dates and assets.
[00:20] Priya Singh: Agenda is pretty simple — positioning, who we're targeting, promotion plan, and then logistics for the platform and dry run.
[01:05] Tom Reynolds: For context, VectorBase will want the webinar to highlight how they used Redwood for lower latency inference at scale, and the main ask is a technical case study plus a demo, about 20 minutes demo, 25 minutes Q&A.
[01:40] Ethan Li: Got it. Proposed length on our side was 45 minutes total — 20 demo, 15 joint discussion, 10 Q&A. That fits.
[02:12] Sasha Ivanov: A note on audience — our list is mostly mid-market data-platform teams, will push via our newsletter and Partner AMP.
[02:45] Lena Park: Great. Target registration goal 1,000 signups, 200 live attendees, 40 demos requested follow-up within 30 days — those are our initial KPIs, ok?
[03:10] Carlos Mendoza: Sounds realistic. We'll do Paid LinkedIn, organic posts, and two email sends + a reminder. Priya, you'll own the nurture?
[03:25] Priya Singh: Yes — I'll draft the main invite, two follow-ups, plus a post-webinar recap. Also will do 3 promotional social posts for Redwood channels.
[04:05] Tom Reynolds: Quick question on platform — are we using ON24 or Zoom? VectorBase prefers ON24 for gated registration and better telemetry.
[04:32] Ethan Li: We can do ON24, but we need to confirm integration with our registration page and whether we can capture the UTM parameters in HubSpot. Carlos?
[04:45] Carlos Mendoza: HubSpot can capture UTMs from ON24 but there is a setup step. I'll put that on my action list to configure tracking.
[05:12] Lena Park: Also need to lock speakers — proposed host: Lena (intro), Tom demo, Maya fireside chat with Q&A moderation by Priya. Agree?
[05:30] Maya Patel: That works for VectorBase. We will provide a 2-slide bio and a headshot.
[06:00] Priya Singh: Please send bios by EOD Friday so I can put them into the deck.
[06:20] Sasha Ivanov: We'll get bios and logo lock by Monday.
[06:45] Lena Park: Great. On the deck — we own the slide template, Redwoods slides will include 3 customer quotes, a short architecture slide, and demo step-by-step. We'll share draft slides by Thursday.
[07:10] Tom Reynolds: For the demo, we'll showcase: 1) basic inference request, 2) latency improvements with batching/caching, and 3) Dedicated vs Hosted options. Heads up — sometimes 'KV cache' in our slides is written as K-V cache, minor transcription.
[07:45] Carlos Mendoza: Good, let's make sure we don't get too deep into kernel-level stuff in the main webinar — keep it approachable. The technical deep dive can be a follow-up webinar.
[08:10] Priya Singh: We should have a short post-demo poll — "Would you like a technical deep dive?" — that will help qualify leads.
[08:35] Maya Patel: Agreed. Also co-marketing assets: VectorBase requests a joint landing page with both logos and an intro paragraph. We need to confirm logo lock and brand colors.
[09:00] Ethan Li: Action item — Maya, can you send approved VectorBase logos and brand guide?
[09:06] Maya Patel: Yes, I'll send that by Monday.
[09:25] Speaker 1: (laughs) There was a small mix-up last time with timezone conversions; let's make sure final calendar invites show Pacific time clearly.
[09:40] Lena Park: Agreed. Dry run planning — propose 2025-04-16 17:00 UTC (10:00 PDT) for a 60-minute rehearsal. Will that work for VectorBase?
[10:00] Tom Reynolds: That works for me.
[10:20] Sasha Ivanov: Works on our side.
[10:45] Priya Singh: Dry run will include walkthrough of slides, demo tech check (network, credentials), screen share handoff, and Q&A moderation run-through.
[11:15] Carlos Mendoza: On tracking — we want UTM with source=linkedin, campaign=redwood_vectorbase_webinar, medium=email. Also conversion event in HubSpot: attended_webinar = true.
[11:40] Lena Park: We'll put that in the runbook. Ethan will own runbook creation.
[12:05] Ethan Li: I'll make a runbook with timing, speaker cues, fallback plan (if demo fails, switch to recorded video), and tech contacts. I'll share by 2025-04-10.
[12:30] Tom Reynolds: On backup demo, VectorBase can provide a recorded demo clip if needed, 5 minutes max. We'll prep that.
[12:50] Maya Patel: One more ask — can Redwood share a short one-pager about Dedicated and Private deployment options that we can promote to our enterprise audience? Might be a gated resource for post-webinar nurture.
[13:10] Lena Park: Yes, we have a 2-page sell sheet; Priya, can you attach that to the post-webinar MQL flow?
[13:22] Priya Singh: Yep. I'll also make a short checklist for demo attendees to request follow-up.
[13:40] Speaker 2: (brief crosstalk)
[14:00] Sasha Ivanov: Operationally, we need the registration form fields. Proposed: First name, Last name, Email, Company, Job title, Use case (dropdown), Consent checkbox, and an optional question: "Interested in a pilot?"
[14:25] Carlos Mendoza: Add a UTM hidden field and "How did you hear about this event?" as well.
[14:40] Lena Park: Good. Also GDPR consent language — Tom, can you confirm VectorBase legal is ok with our default consent?
[14:50] Tom Reynolds: I'll confirm.
[15:10] Priya Singh: For promotional timeline — Week 0: announce, email 1; Week 1: paid push + social; Week 2: reminder email; 2 days before: reminder email + social. Post-webinar: on-demand page + nurture sequence at 1, 7, 21 days.
[15:45] Carlos Mendoza: I'll prepare an ad budget recommendation and forecast.
[16:10] Lena Park: On the run of show, who will do the engineering intro? I can handle high level but we'd prefer a short Redwood engineer slide then hand to Tom for demo.
[16:30] Tom Reynolds: I'll cover the core architecture during the demo part. Please keep latency slides simple with numbers and expected ranges.
[17:00] Maya Patel: VectorBase will provide a customer quote slide and will approve all references to their metrics. We'll need to sign off on final copy.
[17:25] Lena Park: We'll send a copy for approval; please allow 48 hours for content sign-off.
[17:40] Ethan Li: Tech checklist — check speaker audio levels, ensure Presenter view is working, test screen sharing resolution, and confirm recording destination. Also test ON24 integration if used.
[18:05] Priya Singh: Any concerns about time zones for live Q&A? If we get international audience, might be late for EMEA. Suggest scheduling to capture mostly Americas.
[18:30] Tom Reynolds: Agreed, target Americas; we can do a separate EMEA-focused session later.
[18:50] Lena Park: For measuring success, primary: registrations, live attendees, demo requests, and MQL conversion. Secondary: watch time and on-demand plays. We'll capture NPS-ish poll at end.
[19:15] Maya Patel: One more note, we'll cross-promote via VectorBase partner newsletter on the day of the event.
[19:35] Carlos Mendoza: Ok, I'll coordinate the co-marketing list.
[20:00] Lena Park: Quick recap of deliverables and owners — I'll send as follow-up. Anything else?
[20:12] Tom Reynolds: Nothing here. Looking forward to dry run.
[20:25] Maya Patel: Thanks everyone.
[20:30] Lena Park: Thanks all, we'll circulate the deck and runbook this week.
[20:40] (call ends)

Notes: occasional transcription mistakes present — e.g., "KV cache" sometimes transcribed as "K-V cash"; speaker labels simplified in export. Links mentioned during meeting: draft slide link (https://redwood.app/slides/vecb-webinar-draft), registration form placeholder (https://redwood.app/events/vecb-webinar-register).
